messages.content: 请帮我生成一组多轮对话数据,里面包含了LLM function call

function.name: get_current_weather
function.description: Retrieves the current weather conditions for a specified city and state. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The location for which to get the weather, in the format of 'City, State', such as 'San Francisco, CA' if State for the city exists. 'City, Country' if State for the city doesn't exist.

unit.description: The unit of temperature for the weather report.

message.content:
下面给出三组示例多轮对话，每组对话都包含了 LLM 的 function call（使用 `get_current_weather`）。  
对话结构采用 OpenAI 官方的消息格式：  

```json
{
  "role": "assistant",
  "content": null,
  "function_call": {
    "name": "get_current_weather",
    "arguments": "{\"location\":\"...\", \"unit\":\"...\"}"
  }
}
```

随后函数返回：

```json
{
  "role": "function",
  "name": "get_current_weather",
  "content": "{\"temperature\":..., \"description\":\"...\"}"
}
```

最后助手根据返回结果回复用户。  
以下为完整的 JSON 示例（每个数组元素是一条完整对话）：

```json
[
  [
    {"role":"user","content":"今天天气怎么样？"},
    {"role":"assistant","content":null,"function_call":{"name":"get_current_weather","arguments":"{\"location\":\"北京, 中国\",\"unit\":\"celsius\"}"}},
    {"role":"function","name":"get_current_weather","content":"{\"temperature\":22,\"description\":\"晴朗\"}"},
    {"role":"assistant","content":"今天北京的天气是晴朗，温度22摄氏度。"}
  ],
  [
    {"role":"user","content":"What’s the weather like in San Francisco today?"},
    {"role":"assistant","content":null,"function_call":{"name":"get_current_weather","arguments":"{\"location\":\"San Francisco, CA\",\"unit\":\"fahrenheit\"}"}},
    {"role":"function","name":"get_current_weather","content":"{\"temperature\":68,\"description\":\"多云\"}"},
    {"role":"assistant","content":"Today in San Francisco it’s cloudy with a temperature of 68°F."}
  ],
  [
    {"role":"user","content":"上海明天会下雨吗？"},
    {"role":"assistant","content":null,"function_call":{"name":"get_current_weather","arguments":"{\"location\":\"上海, 中国\",\"unit\":\"celsius\"}"}},
    {"role":"function","name":"get_current_weather","content":"{\"temperature\":27,\"description\":\"阴天\"}"},
    {"role":"assistant","content":"上海明天的天气是阴天，温度27摄氏度。"},
    {"role":"user","content":"那后天呢？"},
    {"role":"assistant","content":null,"function_call":{"name":"get_current_weather","arguments":"{\"location\":\"上海, 中国\",\"unit\":\"celsius\"}"}},
    {"role":"function","name":"get_current_weather","content":"{\"temperature\":29,\"description\":\"多云\"}"},
    {"role":"assistant","content":"后天下午的天气是多云，温度29摄氏度。"}
  ]
]
```

> **说明**  
> - `arguments` 字段必须是一个合法的 JSON 字符串。  
> - `content` 字段在函数调用时为 `null`，在函数响应时为返回的 JSON 字符串。  
> - 对话中的 `location` 可以使用 “城市, 国家” 或 “城市, 州” 的格式。  
> - 如果你想让对话更长，只需继续添加更多的用户/助手/函数消息即可。
